title: Require Domain Subdomain Source Topology
forbids: semantic module roots outside their positive contract, router, operation, model, and artifact spine
why: A semantic module is one non-empty operation contract and router boundary. Its local vocabulary lives under model/, immutable data products live under artifacts/, and each nested kind retains its own authority.
remediate: Keep index.ts, contract.ts, router.ts, and ops; retain model or artifacts only when the module owns those capabilities; move every other child to its actual kind owner.
message: Domain modules should match the positive semantic-router blueprint spine.
